  - `seatIntakeKeys` reads `area:x` and `epic #N` / `epic:#N` off a `repo:<this repo>` title, and only there. A sibling repo, `@ elsewhere`, `domain:*` and triage all give `[]`.

    - seat 1: `area:build + area:fleet` → two keys
    - seat 5: `area:ux（待 #35205 回填）` → `area:ux`; the full-width bracket stops the token, and `#35205` is not read as an epic

  - H39 buckets by intake plus `repo:*`.
  - H73 names the seat by areas or "the epic its sub-issue parent is", with no tracker number in the sentence, as its rule requires.
  - H74 inherits by `area:*` or `priority:*`.

- **Epic subtree reading: accepted as direct parent.** `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈Epic 子树车道〉 says 「子卡一律 `sub_issue_add` 挂父单」. Measured on #34571: 2 of its 72 children head sub-issues of their own (#35442, #35445). Those four grandchildren are `pm:queue`/`pm:blocked` follow-ups, and each carries its own `area:*`, so they read on their area seat. That is the follow-up routing the board uses.

It was left alone to avoid #35532 (open), which edits next to it. The carrier is whichever of #35587 and #35532 lands second. Fold the word into the coming delta if #35532 has landed by then, or else leave a one-line note on #35532.
